City of Encinitas
San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 20, 2024 -
05:30 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
S1.
CALL TO ORDER
San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
S2.
ROLL CALL
S3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
S4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS – NONE
S5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
(30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the General Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
S6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
S7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
S8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Board Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval to waive the full reading of the text of all ordinances and resolutions introduced/adopted at this meeting. Ordinances and resolutions shall be introduced/adopted by title only. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve.
8B.
Approval of the Minutes of the October 16, 2024, Special Closed Session Meeting; and October 16, 2024, Regular Meeting. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2024-11-20 SDWD Item S08B Minutes
8C.
Approval of the Warrants List (Register of Demands). Contact Person: Finance Manager Dinh
Staff recommends that the Board review and approve the warrants.
2024-11-20 SDWD Item S08C SDWD Approval of Warrants List
8D.
Reject bid for Annual Asphalt Repair and Services Contract. Environmental Considerations: The proposed project is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15301 (c) of the CEQA Guidelines. This section exempts projects characterized as minor alterations to public facilities, involving negligible or no expansion on the existing use. This annual Asphalt repair contract is a water maintenance project and therefore, meets the criteria for this exemption. Contact Person: Operations Manager Gonzalez
1) Reject the incomparable bids received from the September 5, 2024, bid opening for the Annual Asphalt Repair and Services contract; and 2) Authorize staff to re-advertise and rebid the Annual Asphalt Repair and Services contract.
2024-11-20 SDWD Item S08D Utilities Re-authorization Asphalt RFB
8E.
Quitclaim of Water Easement for the property located at 778 Del Riego Avenue (APN: 256-162-28-00). Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Alex
256-162-28-00)"; and 2) Authorize the General Manager to file a Quitclaim Deed of Public Water Easement.
2024-11-20 SDWD Item S08E Quitclaim 778 Del Riego Ave
8F.
License Agreement with Rancho Coastal Humane Society Regarding Use of a Portion of the San Dieguito Water District Requeza Yard located at 397 Requeza Street (APN: 258-241-30-00). Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it consists of the licensing of facilities involving negligible or no expansion of existing or former use under Section 15301 Class 1 of CEQA Guidelines. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Alex
Approve a License Agreement ("Agreement") with Rancho Coastal Humane Society Regarding Use of a Portion of the Requeza Yard.
2024-11-20 SDWD Item S08F License Agreement with Rancho Coastal Humane Society
8G.
Adopting Terms and Conditions for Grants of Public Water Easements. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Alex
Adopt Resolution No. 2024-21, titled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Adopting Terms and Conditions for Grants of Public Water Easements".
2024-11-20 SDWD Item S08G Adopting Terms and Conditiosn of Grants of Public Water Easements
S9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR
Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
S10.
ACTION ITEMS
To speak on action items, please submit a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present.
10A.
Emergency Repairs for the 36-inch Transmission Main (CW25G). Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board is statutory exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act ("CEQA") under 15269 of CEQA Guidelines as an "Emergency Project" where urgency is required to implement a project that reduce threats to health and property. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Alex
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2024-23, titled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Amending the Fiscal Year 2024-25 Budget" to amend the FY 2024-25 budget by transferring $190,000 from Project No. CW23D Transmission Line Maintenance to fund Project No. CW25G Emergency Repairs to 36-inch Transmission Main; and 2) Authorize the payment of $190,000 to Burtech Pipeline Incorporated for emergency repairs to the 36-inch transmission main located on Rancho Santa Fe Road and El Camino Del Norte.
2024-11-20 SDWD Item S10A Emergency Repair CW25G
S11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS – NONE
To speak on informational items, please submit a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present.
S12.
BOARD MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
S13.
GENERAL INFORMATION / STAFF STATUS REPORTS
13A.
General Manager Update/Report
S14.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR BOARD MEETING WILL BE HELD ON DECEMBER 18, 2024
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
